text:
maya: Heads-up — I found a confusing Java snippet in the Optimize toolkit migration guide about batching + cache + quant profiles. It uses the old SDK builder API (BatchConfig.builder...) that doesn't exist in SDK 1.8. Can someone take a quick pass? Link: https://redwood.dev/docs/optimize/migration/snippets#java

sam: On it. Which exact snippet/line do you mean?

maya: Under 'Batching examples' -> 'per-route config' the snippet shows:
```java
BatchConfig.builder().maxBatchSize(1024).timeoutMs(500).build();
```
The new API is more like:
```java
Optimize.configFor("route").batch().maxSize(1024).timeoutMs(500);
```
so the example is misleading.

sam: Ah, yup. I can open a PR to fix the Java snippet and add a Go parity snippet. Want me to also add a short note about behavioral change (default timeout decreased in the new helper)?

jen: Please do both. Also the quant profiles section still references qprofile v1 which is deprecated; we should point to the qprofiles migration doc and call out dtype canonicalization (fp16 -> int8 guidance).

leo: FYI the internal anchor on that page is currently 404 for me — I opened PR #4321 last week to fix anchors; maybe this page missed the new slug.

docs-bot: PR opened by sam: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4387 — includes Java + Go snippet updates and a brief migration note. CI: running.

ralph: Quick review notes: prefer Optimize.configFor("route") in the Java sample rather than a global builder to avoid implying global mutable state. Also add a bench tip: 'bench with short seqs first' — we've seen perf regressions when people batch long prompts with small kv caches.

sam: Good call. I'll switch to configFor and add a tip: 'prefer batching.maxSize 64 for chat-like traffic' plus a short rationale. I'll also link the sample eval harness (internal) so folks can reproduce the perf note.

maya: :thumbsup: After PR lands can someone backport the snippet fixes to the v1.2 docs branch? A bunch of Dedicated customers still read that version.

jen: I'll handle backport after CI passes. Also can we add a tiny CI checklist in the PR description: run samplegen, run markdown linkcheck, run snippet linter? Saves repeat fixes.

sam: Added that checklist. CI flagged a snippet-lint error (missing newline in Go example). Fixing now.

docs-bot: CI green for PR #4387. Mergeable by reviewers.

leo: Merged. Leaving a follow-up issue to audit all Optimize toolkit pages for stray qprofile references — I'll open it and tag docs.

maya: Thanks all. One more ask: can we add a short migration callout at the top of the guide like 'If you're on SDK >=1.8, see migration notes' so that readers don't miss the API change? I'll create a tiny PR for that after lunch.

sam: Nice. If you want I can add a pointer to the release notes section with the exact SDK version where the change landed.

maya: Please do. That will help support and customers when they file issues.

jen: Good coordination — nailing these small snippet changes reduces a lot of customer confusion.

leo: Filing the audit now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1029. I'll drop a checklist for anchors, qprofile mentions, and snippet parity.

maya: Closing the loop here — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
